allowed_fields: FY2024 and FY2023-comparable revenue and cost for electrical connection
FY2024 and FY2023-comparable revenue and cost for smart electrical and lighting
FY2024 and FY2023 adjusted parent profit only as an optional cross-check
reported segment-definition or perimeter changes

formulas.core_revenue_growth: FY2024 combined core revenue / FY2023 comparable combined core revenue - 1
formulas.core_weighted_gross_margin: 1 - combined core cost / combined core revenue
formulas.core_weighted_gross_margin_change_pp: FY2024 weighted margin minus FY2023 comparable weighted margin in percentage points

first_match: LOCAL_UNKNOWN if a required numeric field is undisclosed or a required denominator is invalid
COMPARABILITY_MISMATCH if segment definitions, period, perimeter, or FY2023 comparatives cannot be bridged
CORE_COMPOUNDING if valid comparable inputs show revenue growth >= 8% and margin change >= -1.0pp
CORE_HOLDING if not compounding and revenue growth >= 0% and margin change >= -2.0pp
CORE_EROSION for the remaining complete, valid, comparable numeric cases

allowed_fields: consolidated operating cash flow
cash paid to acquire fixed, intangible, and other long-term assets
adjusted parent profit
NCI equity and any material non-wholly-owned subsidiary cash attribution
identified maintenance, expansion, fund-raising-project, and unallocated capex
unrestricted cash and cash equivalents
verified assets redeemable before matched short debt maturity
short borrowings and interest-bearing debt due within one year
terms or maturity of closed-end trusts, asset-management plans, and other financial products

formulas.consolidated_conservative_cash_floor: consolidated OCF - all cash long-term-asset purchases
formulas.cash_floor_conversion: conservative cash floor / adjusted parent profit
formulas.nci_immaterial_gate: ratio < 5% and no evidence that material OCF arises in non-wholly-owned subsidiaries
formulas.immediate_liquidity: unrestricted cash and equivalents + assets verified redeemable before matched debt maturity; closed-end products are excluded unless maturity is verified
formulas.immediate_debt_coverage: immediate liquidity / interest-bearing debt due within one year

first_match: LOCAL_UNKNOWN if required OCF, long-term-asset cash purchase, or adjusted-profit denominator is undisclosed or invalid
COMPARABILITY_MISMATCH if the OCF, capex, or profit responsibility boundary cannot be bridged
PARENT_ATTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN if NCI is material and attributable cash is unavailable
LOCAL_UNKNOWN_IMMEDIATE_LIQUIDITY if immediate liquidity or matched one-year debt cannot be identified
CAPEX_PURPOSE_UNKNOWN if conservative cash floor <= 0 and capex purpose cannot be separated
DURABLE_CONSERVATIVE_CASH_FLOOR if valid inputs show cash floor > 0, conversion >= 80%, and immediate debt coverage >= 1
POSITIVE_BUT_MIXED_CASH_FLOOR if not durable, cash floor > 0, and immediate debt coverage >= 1
EXPANSION_FUNDED_CASH if cash floor <= 0, OCF/profit >= 80%, identified growth capex covers the negative floor, and immediate debt coverage >= 1
WEAK_CONSERVATIVE_CASH_FLOOR_OR_LIQUIDITY for the remaining complete, valid, comparable cases

allowed_fields: FY2024 and FY2023-comparable new-energy revenue and cost
FY2024 and FY2023-comparable new-energy production, sales volume, and inventory with units and scope
terminal installations or B-end repeat purchases if disclosed
new-energy operating profit and operating cash investment if disclosed
after-sales and warranty cost if disclosed
new-energy impairment, operating loss plus cash outflow, or irrevocable material capital commitment if disclosed
reported product-definition or perimeter changes

formulas.revenue_growth: FY2024 new-energy revenue / FY2023 comparable revenue - 1
formulas.gross_margin: 1 - FY2024 new-energy cost / FY2024 new-energy revenue
formulas.sales_growth: FY2024 sales volume / FY2023 comparable sales volume - 1
formulas.production_sales_gap_pp: production growth minus sales growth in percentage points

first_match: LOCAL_UNKNOWN if required revenue or cost is undisclosed or a required denominator is invalid
COMPARABILITY_MISMATCH if the product definition, period, perimeter, or FY2023 comparable cannot be bridged
VALUE_DESTRUCTION_EVIDENCED only if an allowed explicit loss, cash-outflow, impairment, warranty, or irrevocable-capital carrier is observed
INCOMPLETE_SCALE_PROOF if revenue and margin are comparable but production, sales, inventory, units, or scope are unavailable or incomparable
QUALITY_SCALE_OPTION_RETAINED if valid scale inputs show revenue growth >= 50%, margin >= 30%, and production-sales growth gap <= 15pp
GROWTH_OPTION_RETAINED_BUT_UNPROVEN if not quality scale, revenue growth > 0%, and margin >= 20%
STALLED_GROWTH_OPTION if not above and revenue growth <= 0%
LOW_QUALITY_OR_INVENTORY_RISK_OPTION for the remaining complete, valid, comparable scale cases

output_requirements: Record raw reported values, units, responsibility boundary, printed page, and source locator before derived values.
Apply first-match in the listed order and state which condition matched.
Keep UNKNOWN and mismatch local; continue settling the other cells.
Do not infer management quality, investment utility, valuation, or enterprise conclusions.
forbidden_inputs: preoutcome judgment narrative or treatment mapping
any source other than the one authorized official annual report
